registered_2024_base_checkpoint.corpus: Cistrome-Human-6K pooled binding-status matrix over 2,137,894 hg38 1-kb bins

post_census_2026_safetensors.rule: This artifact was released after GSE289173 and is not admitted as a conversion of the registered checkpoint without parity and corpus evidence.

input_eligibility.gse281364: The base representation can be associated with a 1-kb region only after an exact roster crosswalk, but it cannot distinguish the MPRA REF and ALT alleles. Retrospective representation diagnostics require a separately frozen allele encoder and head.
input_eligibility.gse289173: Native sealed variant inference is ineligible. The registered checkpoint has no nucleotide input, donor context, gene link, or sign output; REF and ALT at one bin produce the same representation.
input_eligibility.gse296875: Development-only region or regulator probing may be possible after terms and companion-file gates. The model cannot consume same-nucleus RNA as context or emit an ATAC profile.

interpretation: The exact registered base bytes predate GSE289173 and are target-label-unexposed, but that does not make ChromBERT a variant model. It is a pooled Cistrome representation encoder with broad locus and regulatory-profile exposure. The separately released 2026 safetensors identity is post-seal and remains unknown-exposure until a conversion and corpus receipt exists.
remaining_blockers: Obtain written license and derivative-weight terms for the registered source and 2024 checkpoint. Do not infer a grant from a badge or commented package field.

After campaign approval, acquire the exact registered checkpoint, verify SHA-256 and size, isolate PyTorch pickle inspection, export a tensor-only manifest, and require strict restoration against pinned trusted source.
Freeze and hash the exact cistrome, regulator, mask, region, and position order plus a GRCh38.p14-to-native-bin crosswalk; reject non-roster or ambiguous loci.
Prove cell-order and regulator-order invariance fixtures and prevent any held source from selecting regulator subsets, pooled representations, or prompts.

Do not register native allele effects. Any DNABERT-2 or other REF/ALT prompt, decoder, enhancer-gene link, or direction model is a separate composite checkpoint trained only inside donor and genomic folds.
Keep ChromBERT out of the RNA-conditioned ATAC primary endpoint; it has neither observed RNA context nor a genomic ATAC profile head.
Run isolated L40S import, strict restore, forward, backward, resume, deterministic-seed, and cross-device tolerance probes through SLURM only after terms and the artifact bundle are frozen.
